artworks.title: The Court Rules
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate mesh of diagonal lines crisscrossing the scene. A figure resembling a man with glasses and facial features emerges amidst the lines. There is an open book in front of the figure, suggesting someone absorbed in reading or studying.

artworks.title: The Violinist
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a three-quarter view, from the upper torso up, with a portion of their left leg visible. The person is seated and slightly turned towards the left while facing the camera directly, as they appear to be holding a violin in their left hand and a bow in their right hand. The person's facial features are detailed, with a slightly furrowed brow, prominent cheekbones, and a focused expression. Their hair is dark, combed back, and has a slightly wavy texture. The person is wearing a dark jacket over a white shirt with a bow tie. In the background, there is a music stand with a sheet of music on it, and there are lines indicating panels or walls.

artworks.title: The Violinist
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of a man sitting and facing towards the viewer while slightly turned to the right. He is holding a drawing or writing instrument in one hand and a sheet of paper or board in the other. The man's facial features, groomed hair, formal attire, and surroundings are depicted with intricate cross-hatching lines. The background is plain with additional cross-hatching for depth or shading. There is an inscription in the top left corner that reads "D.C. Sturges 1929."

artworks.title: The Violinist
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up, seated and turned towards the right. The person holds a violin, with one hand on the neck and the other holding the bow. The facial expression is concentrated, with detailed features like arched eyebrows and a serious gaze. The person's hair is neatly styled. The attire consists of a formal suit with a bow tie. The background is filled with crosshatched lines, and a music stand with sheet music is visible. The artist's signature and date "D. C. Sturges 1929" are at the top left corner.

artworks.title: The Station Agent
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man sitting at a desk. He has a weathered face, wears glasses, and has short, possibly grey hair. He is dressed in a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a vest, and a tie. In the man's breast pocket of the vest, there is an object protruding. The background shows a framed picture of machinery resembling a train engine. The desk has stacks of papers, books, and a toolbox or briefcase. Light comes in from a window on the right, casting shadows. A chair is partially visible behind the desk.

artworks.title: Canfield
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of a man from the waist up. He is seated, facing to the right, and slightly leaning forward. His facial features are drawn with a focus on shadows and outlines, showing an older man with a prominent nose and wearing round spectacles. His hair appears to be short and receding. He is smoking a cigar, with smoke swirling upwards. He is dressed in a dark coat and in front of him are several cards or papers on a flat surface. The background is plain with faint lines suggesting a window or frame behind him.

artworks.title: The Skipper
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man from the waist up, gripping a ship's steering wheel. His facial features are rugged with a prominent mustache and beard, wearing a cap that casts a shadow over his eyes. He has short, curly hair and is dressed in a coat over a shirt. The background shows a seascape with a horizon line and a few birds in the sky, suggesting an open sea or ocean setting. The etching style provides texture and detail to the scene.

artworks.title: Mother
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman seated at a table, with her head slightly bowed and gazing at an open book in one hand while holding eyeglasses in the other. She has gray hair styled in a bun and wears round spectacles, with a lined face and a neutral expression. She is dressed in a dark dress with a high collar and a brooch at the neckline. Behind her, there is a wooden chair and a framed circular portrait of George Washington on the wall. The background features a sketched floral pattern.

artworks.title: Yarns
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in an outdoor setting. Three are seated and one is standing near a doorway. The seated individuals are depicted from the waist up, wearing hats that partially cover their faces. The standing figure is shown from head to knees, wearing a cap and casual clothing. All figures wear dark clothing, with two wearing hats. One person holds a pipe. The setting is beside a stone building with a "LOBSTERS" sign, suggesting a maritime context. In the background, there is an impressionistic depiction of water and distant land with small birds in flight.

artworks.title: Hear Ye, Hear Ye, Hear Ye
artworks.description: The image shows a man with facial hair standing in front of a window. He is leaning slightly with his arm resting on a surface. He is wearing a double-breasted coat. Around three other figures are partially visible in the background, appearing seated. The setting is indoors, with a wooden bench or table and a large window behind the man. The image is a monochromatic etching.

artworks.title: Lobsterman
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a rowboat, his full upper body and part of his lower body are visible. He is seated hunched forward in the boat, with his hands raised near his mouth obscuring his face. The man is wearing a dark hat and a heavy coat. In the boat, there are ridges of the seat and oars resting across. The background consists of an open sky with scattered clouds, a few birds flying, and faint jagged lines indicating distant mountains.

artworks.title: President Coolidge
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man. The man is facing forward with his head, shoulders, and part of his torso visible. He has distinct facial features, including prominent eyebrows and slightly furrowed brows. His hair is short and neatly combed to the side with a part on the right. The man is dressed in formal attire, wearing a suit jacket, collared shirt, and tie. The portrait focuses on his head and shoulders, with minimal detail on the suit below the chest. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, emphasizing the man. The artist's signature, D.C. Sturgis, is seen in the bottom corners.

artworks.title: Sophia Western, Fieldings Tom Jones
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after John Hoppner
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman shown from the waist up. She is positioned leaning slightly forward with her arms resting on a surface, and her hands are gently clasped together. The woman has a delicate facial expression, with soft features and slightly arched eyebrows, and her lips form a subtle smile. Her hair is styled in loose curls, and she is wearing a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a ribbon that frames her face. Her attire consists of a dress with a fitted bodice, decorated with ruffles around the neckline, and a scarf draped around her shoulders. She is wearing earrings. The background is dark, which highlights her illuminated figure.

artworks.title: Richard Robinson
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a three-quarter body portrait. He has white, curly hair and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a long coat, a waistcoat, a cravat, gloves, and holding a cane. He is looking at the viewer. The background consists of trees, foliage, and a tower in the distance.

artworks.title: Lieutenant Colonel Sir Banastre Tarleton
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on top of a military cannon. He is positioned with his legs straddling the barrel, facing partly to the right of the image while turning his head to look to the left. His facial features are youthful with a clean-shaven face and distinct eyebrows. He has short, wavy hair mostly hidden by a military-style hat with a fur plume. He wears a buttoned military coat, white breeches, tall boots, and holds a curved sword (sabre) in gloved hands, resting it against his knee. Large pieces of fabric are wrapped around him and the cannon. A horse is seen behind him on the left, with its head visible and wearing a bridle. The background is filled with billowing clouds.

artworks.title: In the Rain: Mother and Children (Sous la pluie: La mere et les enfants)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures walking against the wind. The image depicts three figures on the left struggling to move forward as they battle against a strong wind. The figures appear determined and resilient, their clothes and hair flowing backward. The background shows a simple, abstract landscape of swirling lines. This minimalistic style focuses on the movement and struggle against the elements.

artworks.title: In the Rain: Mother and Children (Sous la pluie: La mere et les enfants)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of five people, including a woman and four children, shown in full body. The woman stands in the center, leaning forward slightly while carrying a child in her arms and holding a large bundle. Her facial features are drawn with concentration, and she wears a headscarf. The children around her are clutching hands and looking forward, dressed in long coats, pants, and head coverings. One little girl mirrors the woman by holding a similar bundle against her side. The environment around them seems to depict a barren or windy landscape, with trees bending and a textured sky, suggesting strong winds. The lines convey movement and struggle within an empty background.

artworks.title: Waiting (En attendant)
artworks.description: Several people are depicted from the waist up, gathered around a large pot. A woman is pouring soup from a ladle into a bowl held by a young girl in front of her. The woman has her hair tied up and wears a cap or headscarf and a dress with a prominent collar. The young girl is in profile, holding a bowl with both hands, with dark hair falling to her shoulders. Beside her, a small boy looks up towards the pot, wearing a cap and a dark coat. An elderly man with a bald head and bushy beard stands to the left, holding a dish close to his chest and looking towards the woman serving the soup. The background is crowded with other individuals, outlined in monochrome, creating a somber and communal atmosphere. An inscription, "en attendant!", is in the upper left corner, and the artist's signature, “Steinlen,” is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Girls Coming from School (Gamines sortant de l'ecole)
artworks.description: The image features three young girls walking side by side. The central girl is linking arms with the others. The girls have simplified facial features and curly/wavy hair. They are dressed in long, flowing clothes with capes. The girl closest to the viewer holds an open book. Other figures in the background are dressed similarly and appear to be children or young individuals walking in groups. The setting is outdoors with a minimalist background of a street or open space with a fence.

artworks.title: Prophet (Le prophete)
artworks.description: In the image, there are several figures depicted. The central figure is standing upright with outstretched arms. This person has a beard and little to no hair on the head. The facial features are defined with shadowing, and the hair is short. They are wearing a long robe or garment. Surrounding this figure is a group of people looking towards them. The individuals have varying facial expressions, and some wear hats. The background has hatched lines for depth, making the figures stand out. The scene's edges have sketch-like quality lines, and the artist's signature is in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Poor People (Les pauvres gens)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people. Most individuals are in a seated or crouched position, with the focus being on an older man with a cap holding a child in his lap. There is an older woman beside him and a young girl holding a baby on the other side. Another child is crouched in front, holding flowers. They are all dressed in simple clothing, and there are scattered items in the background. The backdrop is minimal, with sketched lines indicating space. There is no visible jewelry, and the image is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Exodus (L'exode)
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting multiple people sitting together. The scene shows three individuals huddled close to one another on the ground. The figures are bundled in heavy clothing, with hoods and hats covering their heads. The person on the far left appears to have a beard. One person holds what appears to be a child wrapped in layers. The ground around them suggests a barren landscape. In the background, lines sketch the suggestion of a hill or mountain range under a textured sky. The image uses shading to convey depth and texture.

artworks.title: Three Companions (Les trois compagnons)
artworks.description: The image shows three people in a desolate landscape. Two people are standing and one person is sitting. The figure on the left holds a cane in their left hand and gestures with their right hand. They wear a cap and a bulky coat. The other standing person is slightly behind and to the left, leaning forward and wearing a cap and heavy coat. Both have full beards. The seated man on the right wears a loose garment and has long hair and a sparse beard. He looks towards the standing individuals. The background is a simple, open landscape with distant, indistinct shapes.

artworks.title: Soldiers on Leave - Night Scene (Permissionnaires - Effet de Nuit)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures gathered together in conversation. The drawing shows a group of individuals dressed in heavy coats and carrying backpacks. They are standing closely together, possibly engaged in discussion. In the background, shadowy figures and buildings are visible. On the left side, there are several smaller sketches of faces. The use of cross-hatching and strong contour lines give the work a dynamic appearance. This drawing is in the style of Théophile Steinlen.
